cohort: The study included 200 pregnant women with term pregnancies, Bishop scores <6, and cephalic fetal presentation.
finding: Mifepristone administration effectively increased Bishop scores and reduced the induction-to-delivery interval compared to placebo.
mod_finding: The mifepristone group experienced a higher rate of normal vaginal deliveries (73% vs 64%) and lower rates of instrumental deliveries (14% vs 16%) and LSCS (13% vs 20%) compared to the control group.
